image_description: A flat-lay photograph of an open vintage comic book spread. The pages show signs of aging (yellowing) and wear. The layout consists of multiple irregular panels containing hand-drawn illustrations of sci-fi/fantasy characters, including a green-skinned figure in the center and various alien creatures. Speech bubbles and caption boxes with text are visible throughout the panels.

artifact_observations.location: Speech bubbles and caption boxes throughout the page
artifact_observations.reasoning: While the text mimics the visual structure of language, close inspection reveals that many words are nonsensical, misspelled, or composed of pseudo-letters (e.g., 'MAGAZINE' looks slightly distorted, other bubble text is illegible gibberish). This is a common AI artifact where text structure is preserved but semantic content fails.

The texture of the paper has a uniform, slightly 'smudged' or painterly quality rather than the sharp dot-matrix or halftone pattern expected in printed comics. Some ink lines bleed into the paper texture unnaturally.
The blue creature/character in the bottom right panel has indistinct anatomy; limbs and facial features merge together without clear structural definition, appearing 'melted'.
